scope: Conservative source-backed declaration acknowledgement in direct conversation; not a general response semantic verifier
known_outputs_used_for_design: Existing 52 and prospective12 development outputs; subsequent reruns are development regression, not fresh validation
comparison: Same prompt in both arms; candidate additionally source-grounded lookups and declaration routing. Report native generation and deterministic routing separately. Defaults remain false.

constraints: Every input clause must be a recognized fact declaration, third-party introduction or narrow introduction tail
A self acknowledgement must match currently active profile and independently validated current source facts
Requests, emotional elaboration, quoted writing tasks, questions and conditionals remain generative or existing safety routes
No affirmative offline promise or guessing of an unconfirmed user name in deterministic acknowledgement
Unrecognized conversations are outside coverage; all native and final replies retained
No global release from a passing regression score
